acceptance_criteria.criterion: Function signature matches: log_tool_calls(tools: list[Any], stage: str, wp_id: str, logger: WorkflowLogger | None) -> list[Any]
Emitted event contains action: 'tool_call', tool_name, tool_wp_id, and level: 'DEBUG'
Calling log_tool_calls() twice on the same tool list does not stack wrappers (sentinel check)
When logger is None, no error is raised and tools function normally
Tool call arguments are NOT included in the emitted event (privacy constraint)
Original ainvoke return value is forwarded unchanged

summary: Implemented log_tool_calls() in orchestrator/src/utils/tool_wrappers.py following the established sentinel pattern.
Uses _orig_ainvoke_log sentinel for idempotency — stacking is impossible even when the same tool instances are reused.
Extracts work_package_id from both flat-dict and ToolCall {'args': {...}} input structures without logging the full argument payload.
Emits tool_call event with stage, wp_id, action, tool_name, tool_wp_id, level:DEBUG fields via logger.stream_entry().
Returns tools unchanged (no wrapping) when logger is None.
Updated module docstring to document the third wrapper function and its design notes.
Added TYPE_CHECKING guard for WorkflowLogger import to avoid any runtime circular-import risk.
All 50 existing tests pass; no regressions.

comments.note: No security findings — all OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed; no Critical or High issues identified. A03 (Injection): tool_wp_id from user-controlled input flows into stream_entry(), which uses json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False) — all special characters properly escaped, no JSONL injection possible. A04 (Insecure Design): privacy constraint correctly enforced — only tool.name and work_package_id are captured; full argument payload explicitly excluded. A08 (Integrity): _orig_ainvoke_log sentinel + object.__setattr__ is the established Pydantic-bypass pattern used consistently by all three wrappers; idempotency prevents closure stacking. No new third-party dependencies introduced.
